_README: Insulin exposure outside an inpatient stay: the insulin half of the Iannuzzi insulin_dep item (2 points).
ATC 21600713 INSULINS AND ANALOGUES plus descendants, exactly as covariates/covariate_concepts.csv :: insulin_dep,
excluding any exposure that falls within an inpatient stay (see the "Not during an inpatient stay" inclusion rule).
The item is "who with diabetes is currently on insulin": this cohort within the prior 365 days AND a diabetes diagnosis
at any time before index (cohort 9100021), combined at score level via cohort_map.csv and_cohort_id.
Renamed 2026-11-05 from "Insulin-Treated Diabetes" (it no longer contains the diabetes requirement itself).

PrimaryCriteriaLimit / QualifiedLimit / ExpressionLimit are all "All" and EndStrategy is StartDate+0, unlike the [DVI] VA-FI cohorts (1797948-1797977) which are "First". A first-ever-only cohort cannot answer a lookback-window question.

InclusionRules.name: Not during an inpatient stay
InclusionRules.description: Zero inpatient visits (9201 Inpatient Visit, 262 Emergency Room and Inpatient Visit, with descendants) that span the insulin exposure start date: a visit that started on or before that date (StartWindow, unbounded back to day 0) AND ended on or after it (EndWindow, day 0 onward). This is what 'outpatient' means for the Iannuzzi insulin item: insulin given or prescribed while the patient was NOT hospitalized (chosen 2026-11-05 as the cleanest rule; inpatient sliding-scale and drip insulin are excluded). Exposures with no visit link are kept, ED-only visits are not excluded. Implementation note: the EndWindow must have UseEventEnd = true so Circe compares the visit END date; without it Circe tests the visit start date twice and only visits starting on the exposure date are excluded (caught by tests/regression/test_insulin_item.R).
